item.tib: gdugs dkar rigs sngags rgyal mo'i rgyud las dmod bcol dug mtsho khol ma
item.coloph: ces gshen rab mchog gi gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi rgyud las dmod bcol dug mtsho khol ma 'di yang / bstan sbyin rtsa grogs las slob rjes 'jug rnams kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyag cha ru/ kho bo kun grol grags pas shar rong rnam dag bkod pa yi/ zhing gi byang phyogs bsod nams ne bus pa'i tha bru (gru) la tsam (brtsams) pa/ dus kyis pho nya'i zla tshes su i thi//
